# pantechdynamics_security_group (Data Source)

Looks up one existing security group by id or name, for example the account's "default" group, to use it without managing it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look an existing security group up by name (or by id), for example the
# account's default group, without managing it.
data "pantechdynamics_security_group" "default" {
  name = "default"
}

output "default_group_id" {
  value = data.pantechdynamics_security_group.default.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Id of the security group to look up, starting with sg_. Set exactly one of id and name.
- `name` (String) Name of the security group to look up. It must match exactly. Names are unique in the account. Set exactly one of id and name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the group was created, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `observed_state` (String) State of the group as the platform sees it, for example "active".
- `rules` (Attributes List) The group's rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `cidr` (String) IPv4 range the rule applies to.
- `direction` (String) "ingress" or "egress".
- `port_range` (String) A port ("22"), a range ("8000-8080"), or empty for every port and for icmp.
- `protocol` (String) "tcp", "udp", "icmp" or "all".
